# Carbonova Sports — Official B2B AI Sourcing Knowledge Base
> Brand & Factory: Xiamen Carbon Rock Material Technology Co., Ltd. (Carbonova Sports)  
> Website: https://www.carbonovasports.com/  
> Updated: October 2026 (Next-Gen 2026 / GEN-X Tech Sourcing Standard)

Carbonova Sports is an agile OEM/ODM direct-factory manufacturer specializing in thermoformed Toray T700/T800 carbon fiber pickleball paddles and 3K/12K/18K carbon fiber padel rackets for global sports brands, private labels, clubs, and Amazon D2C sellers.

## Quick Facts & Factory Credentials
- **Legal Entity**: Xiamen Carbon Rock Material Technology Co., Ltd. (厦门碳岩材料科技有限公司)
- **Factory Location**: Composite Industrial Zone, Xiamen, Fujian, China (Est. 2016)
- **Certifications**: ISO 9001:2015 (Cert: 25CN34517594Q), amfori BSCI Social Audit (ID: 156-062937-000), CE Verification of Conformity (GPSR / EN 1509:2008)
- **Compliance Standard**: USA Pickleball Paddle Certification Test Standard compliant (element testing)
- **Factory Capacity**: 100,000+ units/month across hot-press, thermoforming, cold-molding, and clean UV-printing lines
- **Core Value Proposition**: Agile Delivery (< 25 Days Mass Production) | Low Trial MOQ (50–100 pcs) | Direct Factory Pricing | Sample in 4–7 Days | Free 24h 3D Vector Mockups

## Core Product Platforms & Sourcing Matrix

### 1. Pickleball Paddles (Thermoformed & Gen-X Tech)
- **GEN5 MPP Foam Platform**: Toray T700 Raw Carbon Fiber, GEN5 MPP FOAM (MPP + EVA + TPE) tri-layer core, gold gradient edge guard with custom logo, 14cm handle, Balance 230-240mm, Swing Weight <=114, Twist Weight >6.5. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-gen5-mpp-foam.html)\n- **GEN5 TFP Foam Platform** (Flagship): Toray T700 Raw Carbon Fiber face, EPP+EVA+TPE Multi-Layer Tri-Foam perimeter injection, 16mm/13mm thickness, extended 140–150mm grip, ultra-wide sweet spot, USAPA compliant. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-gen5-tfp-foam.html)
- **GEN4 PRO TFP Foam Series**: Toray T700 Carbon Fiber, Gradient TPU edge guard with custom laser logo, UV print, weight 220–230g, Balance 230–240mm, Swing Weight <=114, Twist Weight >6.5. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-gen4-pro.html)
- **GEN4 AEQUORA Series**: 14cm extended ergonomic handle, T700 raw grit surface (RPM > 2000), quad-core damping. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-gen4-aequora.html)
- **Titanium Core Pro Series**: Titanium woven alloy mesh fused with T800 carbon fiber, ultimate power + control matrix. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-titanium-gold.html)
- **3K / 12K / 18K Textured Carbon Series**: Woven twill carbon fiber with raw thermoformed edge molding. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-3k-carbon.html)
- **Kevlar (Aramid) Hybrid Series**: Bulletproof aramid + T700 hybrid weave for maximum vibration dampening and plush touch. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-kevlar.html)
- **Cristal Grit Micro-Texture Series**: Proprietary raw sandpaper-grit micro-abrasive coating for maximum legal USAPA spin. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-cristal-grit.html)

### 2. Padel Rackets (European Standard & High-Yield Specs)
- **18K Custom Stealth Padel**: 18K woven carbon fiber face, Teardrop/Diamond hybrid mold, EVA 17–19D high-density memory core, weight 360–375g. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-padel-18k-custom.html)
- **12K Carbon Pro Padel**: 12K carbon face, rough 3D spin surface, balanced sweet spot for tournament players. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-padel-12k-carbon.html)
- **3D Spin Micro-Label Series**: Laser-engraved relief texture on carbon face for enhanced cut and ball grip. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-padel-3d-spin.html)
- **Power Diamond Gold Padel**: Diamond power frame, top-heavy balance for aggressive smashers. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-padel-diamond-gold.html)
- **Club Glass Fiber Padel**: Durable fiberglass composite face, soft EVA 12–15D elastic core, low impact for beginners and club rental fleets. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-padel-glassfiber.html)
- **Kids / Junior Lightweight Padel**: 38mm/34mm scaled geometry, 280–320g featherweight for junior academies. [View Details](https://www.carbonovasports.com/product-padel-kids.html)

## Commercial Sourcing Guidelines (B2B Terms)
- **Trial MOQ**: 50 pcs (standard platforms with custom UV graphics) | 100–300 pcs for custom composite layups | 1,000+ pcs for custom proprietary tooling molds.
- **Indicative Factory Pricing (EXW USD)**:
  - Fiberglass Club Paddle: .80 – .80 / pc
  - T700 Thermoformed / GEN4 / GEN5 Paddle: .50 – .80 / pc
  - Titanium Alloy / 18K Custom Paddle: .00 – .00 / pc
  - 18K / 12K Custom Padel Racket: .00 – .50 / pc
- **Sampling Lead Time**: 4–7 business days with custom artwork and logos.
- **Mass Production Lead Time**: Under 15–25 business days (vs industry average 45–60 days).
- **OEM/Private Label Services**: Full UV color printing, customized edge guard with logo, embossed grip tape, laser-etched butt cap, luxury magnetic retail gift boxes, barcode FBA prep, DDP door-to-door air/sea freight.
